source_user_request: fait toutes les armures de toutes les classes puis ensuite tu me montreras l'ensemble en taille réelle pour voir lesquelles seront à modifier / garder :)
workflow: Prepare all classes before joint visual review; this supersedes the earlier one-class-at-a-time review cadence. No new art is accepted by this production request.

classes.name: Traqueuse
classes.identity: A compact ATHLETIC ADULT WOMAN scout. Keep the female body, stance, normal limb count and the reference's one cybernetic forearm and opposite cybernetic lower leg. Practical utilitarian silhouette, narrow shoulders and waist, agile ranger outline. OLIVE / CHARCOAL equipment, a small muted OCHRE marking. Fitted short tactical garments and angled low-profile protection. No long coat, robe, hood, huge square shoulder blocks or bulky melee armor.

classes.name: Arcaniste
classes.identity: A TALL SLENDER ADULT MALE cybernetic arcanist. Keep the reference's slim male anatomy and copper/ceramic channeling forearms and hands. Long vertical ceremonial TECH-TABARD shapes and an ivory central strip over BURGUNDY / CHARCOAL clothing. A narrow high structural collar, geometric copper conductors and ceramic masses. No open buttoned technician trenchcoat, teal cloth hood, giant square melee pauldrons or floating magical effects.

classes.name: Métamorphe
classes.identity: A MUSCULAR COMPACT ADULT WOMAN, human at rest, based on the reference. Keep her female face/body identity, strong human arms, normal hands, two normal legs and feet. Clothing is advanced flexible BIOWEAVE and manufactured organic-looking CHITIN armor, deep PLUM/CHARCOAL and warm TAWNY BONE. Curved overlapping shell masses and rib-like armor seams, no square military plates. These are wearable protections, not a bodily mutation: no claws, fangs, horns, animal head, tail, wings, extra limbs or monstrous anatomy. Functional covered torso, no sexualized armor, heels or breast cups.

jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: separate class-specific DEFAULT HEADGEAR OVERLAY for a 64x64 roguelike.
Input role: class material/identity reference ONLY. Draw ONLY the physical protection. No head anatomy, person, face, flesh, eye drawn beneath open gear, hair, mannequin, neck or shoulders. Straight frontal worn view, centered, ample transparent margins.
A real existing class head is placed behind this overlay. All areas described as open must be genuinely ALPHA-ZERO TRANSPARENT, never a black face, interior liner, rear shell or tinted rectangle. Opaque lens is allowed only where requested.
Native item is only 5-7 pixels tall and 10-12 wide, so use extremely few broad shapes, 2-3 tones, a readable dark outline. No tiny detail, rivets, texture, halo or ground shadow. Genuine transparent background, no text or labels.

A compact ATHLETIC ADULT WOMAN scout. Keep the female body, stance, normal limb count and the reference's one cybernetic forearm and opposite cybernetic lower leg. Practical utilitarian silhouette, narrow shoulders and waist, agile ranger outline. OLIVE / CHARCOAL equipment, a small muted OCHRE marking. Fitted short tactical garments and angled low-profile protection. No long coat, robe, hood, huge square shoulder blocks or bulky melee armor.
A separate asymmetrical SCOUT SENSOR GUARD: one small charcoal and olive temple mount joined to a very thin dark upper-brow strap, with ONE slanted blue smoked monocular lens on the viewer's LEFT. Most of the head/face is not drawn and remains genuinely transparent. No face or hair. Compact asymmetric profile, no cap, dome, helmet, hood, ear cups, mask, jaw bar or full-width soldier visor.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: headless scout armor body module for a native64 game.
Edit the referenced outfit to improve readability when reduced to a 46-pixel-tall body. Keep the SAME female body anatomy, exact pose, proportions, hands, cybernetic forearm and opposite robotic lower leg, armor model geometry, footprint, neck-to-soles framing and true transparency. Do not add a head, weapon or object.
Change ONLY the visual value structure of the clothing/protection: the olive vest/jacket/armor surfaces must become LIGHT COOL SAGE-KHAKI with broad clear pale upper planes, well separated from the charcoal flexible underlayer. Strongly increase their brightness so the main chest/shoulder/knee/shin protection reads as separate big light masses at native64. Main protection surfaces should look distinctly LIGHT rather than brown/black camouflage. Keep dark charcoal joints/underclothes, natural skin, white robotic components and the few amber identity marks.
Simplify the inner shading into 2-3 broad values per material, remove tiny seams and noisy shading; preserve the big existing panels and dark outer contour. No extra armor or added decorations. No new little straps, rivets, fabric texture or speckling. Keep all parts attached and the hands empty.
Do not merely increase the light source, contrast of the background or specular dots. The actual protective material must have broad light sage-khaki middle values. Do not turn it white, teal or gold. Matte functional equipment for a compact female ranged scout.
Transparent background outside the whole body. Remove any aura/halo/vignette if present; leave no ground or cast shadow. Entire soles and hands remain visible.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: headless full outfit body module for a 64x64 cyberpunk roguelike character.
Input image role: reference for the CLASS ANATOMY, POSE, proportions and broad rendering style only. Replace its clothes with the specified armor model.
Draw ONE COMPLETE humanoid body FROM NECK TO BOTH SOLES, straight frontal worn view, relaxed balanced stance, both arms down with a gap from the torso, BOTH EMPTY HANDS visible and fingers inward. Keep the reference class proportions. Entire feet visible, no cropping or stretching.
CRITICAL: NO HEAD, no face, hair, helmet, hood or headgear. Just a short dark neck socket at the top; the exact existing class head is composited separately. No flesh blob at the neck.
The armor of the torso determines the entire worn outfit: arms, gloves, trousers/skirt, leg protection and boots all belong to this model. Clearly change their protection with the requested weight. Empty hands, no weapons, tools, drones, effects or loose objects.
Style: extremely readable native64 GAME SPRITE, few large faceted matte masses, continuous readable dark outer contour, restrained upper-left highlights, 2-3 broad values per material, almost no texture. The finished body is only about 46-48 pixels tall. No miniature buckles, screws, thin wires, tiny seams or dense patterns.
True transparent background outside the complete body, ample clear margin around hands and feet, no ground, shadow, aura, glow, vignette, text, icons or frame.
